logp.method_description: The n-octanol/water partition coefficients were determined at room temperature following a reported method. 1-3 (30 uM) were added in a mixed solution containing 1 mL water and 1 mL n-octanol, then sonicated for 30 min and centrifuged at 4000 rpm for 10 min. The concentrations of complexes in two phases were measured by UV-vis. Each measurement was repeated for 3 times.
